name: upword. Connect
author: goupword

sections.description:
upword. Connect is the publishing bridge between upword. and your WordPress site. Connect once, then every article upword. creates for your business is published directly to your blog — complete with featured images, SEO metadata, and structured data.

What is upword.?

upword. is a content marketing platform built for local service businesses — plumbers, dentists, HVAC companies, law firms, auto shops, and more. It creates original, SEO-optimized blog content designed to help your business show up when customers search Google, ask ChatGPT, or use any AI-powered search tool.

upword. handles the entire content pipeline so you don’t have to:

  • Original articles written for your business — not generic templates. Every article is built around your services, your city, and the questions your customers are actually asking.
  • Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) — content is structured so AI tools like ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, and Perplexity recommend your business by name.
  • Real questions from real people — upword. finds the exact questions potential customers are asking online and turns them into content that brings in ready-to-buy traffic.
  • Automatic scheduling and publishing — new content goes live on your site on a schedule you set, so your online presence grows without weekly effort.
  • SEO metadata handled for you — titles, descriptions, and structured data are generated and applied automatically.

What does upword. Connect do?

This plugin receives articles from upword. and publishes them to your WordPress site. You never have to log in, copy content, upload images, or configure SEO fields manually.

Key features:

  • One-click setup — install, activate, and click “Connect to upword.”
  • Featured images downloaded and stored in your Media Library
  • SEO titles and descriptions applied automatically via Yoast SEO, Rank Math, or custom meta fields
  • JSON-LD structured data added to each article
  • Idempotent publishing — retries update the existing post instead of creating duplicates
  • Secure server-to-server connection — no WordPress passwords are shared or stored

Who is this for?

If you run a local service business and want a steady stream of high-quality blog content without hiring a writer, managing a CMS, or learning SEO — upword. and upword. Connect handle it all.

How it works

  1. Install and activate upword. Connect
  2. Click “Connect to upword.” in Settings
  3. Articles publish to your site automatically

That is it. No ongoing setup and no technical steps required.

Privacy

upword. Connect only stores what is needed to publish your articles.

  • Connection settings are saved on your site
  • Article details are saved on posts created by upword.
  • Images are downloaded to your site when included
  • No WordPress passwords are collected or stored

upword. privacy policy: https://www.goupword.com/legal/privacy
sections.faq:
Do I need to give upword. my WordPress login?

No. You never share your WordPress username or password. The connection uses a secure signed link created during setup.

Will this create duplicate blog posts?

No. If an article is published again or retried, upword. updates the existing post instead of creating a new one.

Will my images be hosted on my site?

Yes. Featured images are automatically downloaded and stored in your WordPress Media Library.

Does this work with SEO plugins?

Yes. upword. Connect works with Yoast SEO and Rank Math out of the box and fills in your SEO title and meta description automatically.

Do I need an upword. account?

Yes. upword. Connect is the publishing plugin for the upword. platform. You can sign up for a free account to get started.

What kind of content does upword. create?

upword. creates original blog articles tailored to your business — local pricing guides, service comparisons, answers to common customer questions, and more. Every article is optimized for both traditional search engines and AI-powered answer tools.
